samples.question: Inside the cyan frame, each of the nine lanes is one compressed row; ignore the gray bars outside. Read separated bars left to right: width in gold-bar lengths is run length, dark expands to dark tiles, and pale expands to blank tiles. Expand each lane to nine tiles, keep lanes top to bottom, and do not rotate or reflect. Which arrow is closest: up, right, down, or left? Closest means fewest differing tiles; ties are ambiguous and quarantined.
